package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode

import dev.pocketrun.core.Workspace
import dev.pocketrun.runtime.js.JsRuntime
import dev.pocketrun.runtime.npm.NpxRuntime
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL

/**
 * The opencode tool set, with opencode's names and semantics: bash, edit,
 * write, read, list, glob, grep, apply_patch, todowrite, webfetch, skill and
 * question. Everything runs inside the workspace sandbox; the `question`
 * tool surfaces an interactive prompt in the chat UI.
 */
class OpenCodeTools(
    private val workspace: Workspace,
    jsRuntime: JsRuntime,
    npxRuntime: NpxRuntime,
    private val projectDir: File?,
    private val githubToken: String = "",
) {

    companion object {
        private const val MAX_READ = 32 * 1024
        private const val MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT = 16 * 1024
        private const val MAX_WEB = 24 * 1024

        /** A single bash command may run this long — npm installs and builds need it. */
        const val BASH_TIMEOUT_MS = 300_000L
    }

    private val shell = MiniShell(workspace, jsRuntime, npxRuntime)
    private val skills = Skills(workspace)

    /** Answers pending questions; set by the agent runner. */
    @Volatile
    var questionAsker: ((List<Question>) -> String)? = null

    /**
     * Manual confirmation gate: return false to refuse the tool call. Only
     * invoked for mutating tools (writes, edits, bash, github mutations);
     * reads always run. Set by the runner when the mode is "manual".
     */
    @Volatile
    var toolApprover: ((name: String, argsJson: String) -> Boolean)? = null

    /**
     * Polled by long-waiting tools (github run_wait) so that ⏹ actually stops
     * a turn that is only waiting for a CI run.
     */
    @Volatile
    var cancelCheck: (() -> Boolean)? = null

    /** Todo updates flow to the session and UI through this hook. */
    @Volatile
    var onTodos: ((List<Sessions.Todo>) -> Unit)? = null

    /** The current todo list; seeded from the session before each turn. */
    var todos: List<Sessions.Todo> = emptyList()

    data class Question(val header: String?, val question: String, val options: List<String>)

    fun definitions(): JSONArray = JSONArray().apply {
        fun tool(name: String, description: String, properties: JSONObject, required: List<String>) {
            put(
                JSONObject().apply {
                    put("type", "function")
                    put(
                        "function",
                        JSONObject().apply {
                            put("name", name)
                            put("description", description)
                            put(
                                "parameters",
                                JSONObject().apply {
                                    put("type", "object")
                                    put("properties", properties)
                                    put("required", JSONArray(required))
                                },
                            )
                        },
                    )
                },
            )
        }

        fun str(name: String, desc: String) = JSONObject().put("type", "string").put("description", desc)
        fun int(name: String, desc: String) = JSONObject().put("type", "integer").put("description", desc)
        fun bool(name: String, desc: String) = JSONObject().put("type", "boolean").put("description", desc)
        fun arr(name: String, desc: String, itemSchema: JSONObject = str("item", "")) =
            JSONObject().put("type", "array").put("items", itemSchema).put("description", desc)

        tool(
            "bash",
            "Execute a shell command in the sandboxed project directory. Available commands: ${MiniShell.COMMANDS.joinToString(", ")}. " +
                "python runs CPython 3.13 (stdlib only), node runs the Node-compatible layer, npx installs/runs pure-JS npm packages. " +
                "Supports quoting, && , | and > >> redirection. No git, no package managers other than npx.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("command", str("command", "the shell command to run"))
                .put("timeout", int("timeout", "optional timeout in milliseconds (max ${BASH_TIMEOUT_MS})")),
            listOf("command"),
        )
        tool(
            "read",
            "Read a text file (max ${MAX_READ} chars). Supports optional offset (1-based line) and limit.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("filePath", str("filePath", "path relative to the project root"))
                .put("offset", int("offset", "1-based line number to start from"))
                .put("limit", int("limit", "number of lines to read")),
            listOf("filePath"),
        )
        tool(
            "write",
            "Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Parent directories are created automatically.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("filePath", str("filePath", "path relative to the project root"))
                .put("content", str("content", "full file content")),
            listOf("filePath", "content"),
        )
        tool(
            "edit",
            "Edit an existing file by replacing an exact string. oldString must be unique in the file unless replaceAll is true.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("filePath", str("filePath", "path relative to the project root"))
                .put("oldString", str("oldString", "the exact text to replace"))
                .put("newString", str("newString", "the replacement text"))
                .put("replaceAll", bool("replaceAll", "replace every occurrence")),
            listOf("filePath", "oldString", "newString"),
        )
        tool(
            "list",
            "List a directory of the project.",
            JSONObject().put("path", str("path", "directory path, '.' is the project root")),
            listOf("path"),
        )
        tool(
            "glob",
            "Find files by glob pattern (e.g. '**/*.py', 'src/**/*.js'), sorted by modification time.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("pattern", str("pattern", "glob pattern"))
                .put("path", str("path", "directory to search in, defaults to the project root")),
            listOf("pattern"),
        )
        tool(
            "grep",
            "Search file contents with a regular expression; returns 'path:line: text' matches.",
            JSONObject()
                .put("pattern", str("pattern", "regular expression"))
                .put("path", str("path", "directory to search in, defaults to the project root"))
                .put("include", str("include", "glob filter for file names, e.g. '*.py'")),
            listOf("pattern"),
        )
        tool(
            "apply_patch",
            "Apply a patch in the *** Begin Patch format with *** Add File / *** Update File (+- lines) / *** Move to / *** Delete File sections.",
            JSONObject().put("patchText", str("patchText", "the full patch text")),
            listOf("patchText"),
        )
        tool(
            "todowrite",
            "Create or update the session todo list. Replaces the whole list; statuses: pending, in_progress, completed.",
            JSONObject().put(
                "todos",
                arr(
                    "todos",
                    "the full todo list",
                    JSONObject().put("type", "object")
                        .put(
                            "properties",
                            JSONObject()
                                .put("id", str("id", "stable id"))
                                .put("content", str("content", "task text"))
                                .put("status", str("status", "pending | in_progress | completed")),
                        )
                        .put("required", JSONArray(listOf("content", "status"))),
                ),
            ),
            listOf("todos"),
        )
        tool(
            "webfetch",
            "Fetch an http(s) URL and return the page as plain text (HTML stripped), max ${MAX_WEB} chars.",
            JSONObject().put("url", str("url", "the URL to fetch")),
            listOf("url"),
        )
        tool(
            "skill",
            "Load a skill (a SKILL.md file) and return its full content. ${"\n"}${skills.availableSkillsXml(projectDir)}",
            JSONObject().put("name", str("name", "skill name to load")),
            listOf("name"),
        )
        tool(
            "question",
            "Ask the user questions with optional choices; use this to clarify requirements or offer directions.",
            JSONObject().put(
                "questions",
                arr(
                    "questions",
                    "one or more questions",
                    JSONObject().put("type", "object")
                        .put(
                            "properties",
                            JSONObject()
                                .put("header", str("header", "short header"))
                                .put("question", str("question", "the question text"))
                                .put("options", arr("options", "answer options", str("option", ""))),
                        )
                        .put("required", JSONArray(listOf("question"))),
                ),
            ),
            listOf("questions"),
        )
        tool(
            "github",
            "Work with GitHub through its REST API: repositories, files, and **GitHub Actions runners**. " +
                "Runners (runs-on: ubuntu-latest) are full Linux machines — there you can run npm packages, " +
                "opencode itself (npm i -g opencode-ai; opencode run \"…\"), compilers, tests — the heavy work " +
                "the mobile sandbox cannot do. Typical flow: repo_create → push (code + .github/workflows/run.yml " +
                "with `on: workflow_dispatch`, all files in ONE commit) → dispatch → run_wait (blocks until the run " +
                "finishes and returns conclusion, jobs and the log tail) → artifacts/artifact_download. " +
                "Never poll `runs` in a loop: run_wait does it in a single call. " +
                "Ops: me; repo_list; repo_create{name,private,description?}; push{repo,files[{path,content}],message,branch?}; " +
                "file_delete{repo,paths[],message,branch?}; file_get{repo,path,ref?}; workflow_create{repo,filename,yaml}; " +
                "dispatch{repo,workflow,ref?}; runs{repo,limit?}; run_wait{repo,run_id?,timeout_sec?}; run_cancel{repo,run_id}; " +
                "logs{repo,run_id}; artifacts{repo,run_id?}; artifact_download{repo,artifact_id}; " +
                "api{method,path,body?} for anything else (PRs, issues, releases). " +
                "Requires a GitHub token in the app settings (⚙ → GitHub, scopes repo+workflow).",
            JSONObject()
                .put("op", str("op", "operation name, see the list above"))
                .put("repo", str("repo", "owner/name"))
                .put("name", str("name", "repo name (for repo_create)"))
                .put("private", bool("private", "create a private repo (repo_create)"))
                .put("description", str("description", "repo description (repo_create)"))
                .put("files", arr("files", "files to push", JSONObject().put("type", "object").put("properties", JSONObject().put("path", str("path", "")).put("content", str("content", ""))).put("required", JSONArray(listOf("path", "content")))))
                .put("paths", arr("paths", "paths to delete (file_delete)", str("path", "")))
                .put("message", str("message", "commit message (push)"))
                .put("branch", str("branch", "branch name (push/file_get)"))
                .put("path", str("path", "file path (file_get)"))
                .put("ref", str("ref", "git ref (file_get/dispatch)"))
                .put("filename", str("filename", "workflow file name, e.g. run.yml (workflow_create)"))
                .put("yaml", str("yaml", "workflow YAML content (workflow_create)"))
                .put("workflow", str("workflow", "workflow file name (dispatch)"))
                .put("run_id", JSONObject().put("type", "integer").put("description", "run id (logs/artifacts/run_wait/run_cancel)"))
                .put("artifact_id", JSONObject().put("type", "integer").put("description", "artifact id (artifact_download)"))
                .put("timeout_sec", int("timeout_sec", "how long run_wait blocks, max ${GitHubClient.MAX_WAIT_SEC} (run_wait)"))
                .put("limit", int("limit", "max runs to list"))
                .put("method", str("method", "HTTP method (api)"))
                .put("api_path", str("api_path", "REST path like /repos/o/n/pulls (api)"))
                .put("body", str("body", "JSON body (api)")),
            listOf("op"),
        )
    }

    /** Executes one tool call; never throws — errors come back as text. */
    fun execute(name: String, argsJson: String): String {
        return try {
            val args = JSONObject(argsJson.ifBlank { "{}" })
            // Manual confirmation gate: mutating tools ask the user first.
            val approver = toolApprover
            if (approver != null && !isReadOnly(name, args)) {
                if (!approver(name, argsJson)) return "(отклонено пользователем)"
            }
            when (name) {
                "bash" -> doBash(args)
                "read" -> doRead(args)
                "write" -> doWrite(args)
                "edit" -> doEdit(args)
                "list" -> doList(args)
                "glob" -> doGlob(args)
                "grep" -> doGrep(args)
                "apply_patch" -> doApplyPatch(args)
                "todowrite" -> doTodoWrite(args)
                "webfetch" -> doWebFetch(args)
                "skill" -> doSkill(args)
                "question" -> doQuestion(args)
                "github" -> doGitHub(args)
                else -> "unknown tool: $name"
            }
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
        }
    }

    /** True when the call cannot change anything (auto-approved in manual mode). */
    fun isReadOnly(name: String, args: JSONObject): Boolean = when (name) {
        "read", "list", "glob", "grep", "webfetch", "skill", "question", "todowrite" -> true
        "github" -> args.optString("op") in GitHubClient.READ_OPS
        else -> false
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- tools

    private fun base(): File = projectDir ?: workspace.root

    private fun doBash(args: JSONObject): String {
        val command = args.getString("command")
        val timeout = args.optLong("timeout", BASH_TIMEOUT_MS).coerceIn(1_000, BASH_TIMEOUT_MS)
        val r = shell.execute(command, base(), timeout)
        val out = buildString {
            append("exit code: ").append(r.exitCode).append('\n')
            if (r.output.isNotBlank()) append(r.output.trimEnd()).append('\n')
        }
        return out.trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT)
    }

    private fun doRead(args: JSONObject): String {
        val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
        if (!f.exists()) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
        if (f.isDirectory) return "error: это каталог, используйте list"
        val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
        val offset = args.optInt("offset", 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
        val limit = args.optInt("limit", 0)
        val lines = text.lines()
        val from = (offset - 1).coerceIn(0, lines.size)
        val to = if (limit > 0) minOf(from + limit, lines.size) else lines.size
        val picked = lines.subList(from, to)
        val body = picked.joinToString("\n")
        return (body.take(MAX_READ) + if (body.length > MAX_READ) "\n… (обрезано)" else "")
            .ifEmpty { "(пустой файл)" }
    }

    private fun doWrite(args: JSONObject): String {
        val path = args.getString("filePath")
        if (path.isBlank()) return "error: пустой путь"
        val f = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
        f.parentFile?.mkdirs()
        f.writeText(args.optString("content", ""), Charsets.UTF_8)
        return "wrote ${args.optString("content", "").length} chars to ${workspace.relativeTo(f)}"
    }

    private fun doEdit(args: JSONObject): String {
        val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
        if (!f.isFile) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
        val old = args.getString("oldString")
        val new = args.optString("newString", "")
        if (old.isEmpty()) return "error: oldString пуст"
        val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
        val count = countOccurrences(text, old)
        if (count == 0) return "error: oldString не найден в файле"
        if (count > 1 && !args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) {
            return "error: oldString встречается $count раз — уточните текст или передайте replaceAll: true"
        }
        val updated = if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) text.replace(old, new) else text.replaceFirst(old, new)
        f.writeText(updated, Charsets.UTF_8)
        return "ok: заменено вхождений: ${if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) count else 1}"
    }

    private fun doList(args: JSONObject): String {
        val path = args.optString("path", ".")
        val dir = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
        if (!dir.exists()) return "error: нет такого каталога: $path"
        if (!dir.isDirectory) return "error: не каталог: $path"
        val entries = dir.listFiles()?.sortedWith(compareByDescending<File> { it.isDirectory }.thenBy { it.name }) ?: return "(empty)"
        if (entries.isEmpty()) return "(empty)"
        return entries.take(200).joinToString("\n") { f -> if (f.isDirectory) f.name + "/" else f.name + " (${f.length()} bytes)" }
    }

    private fun doGlob(args: JSONObject): String {
        val pattern = args.getString("pattern")
        val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
        val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
        val matches = mutableListOf<File>()
        base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
            if (f.isFile) {
                val rel = f.relativeToOrNull(base)?.path ?: return@forEach
                if (globToRegex(pattern).matches(rel)) matches += f
            }
        }
        if (matches.isEmpty()) return "(нет совпадений)"
        return matches.sortedByDescending { it.lastModified() }
            .take(200)
            .joinToString("\n") { workspace.relativeTo(it) }
    }

    private fun doGrep(args: JSONObject): String {
        val pattern = try { Regex(args.getString("pattern")) } catch (t: Throwable) { return "error: плохой regex: ${t.message}" }
        val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
        val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
        val include = args.optString("include").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { globToRegex(it) }
        val out = StringBuilder()
        base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
            if (out.length > MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT) return@forEach
            if (!f.isFile || f.length() > 512 * 1024) return@forEach
            val rel = workspace.relativeTo(f)
            if (include != null && !include.matches(f.name) && !include.matches(rel)) return@forEach
            val text = runCatching { f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) }.getOrNull() ?: return@forEach
            text.lines().forEachIndexed { idx, line ->
                if (pattern.containsMatchIn(line)) out.append("$rel:${idx + 1}: ${line.take(300)}\n")
            }
        }
        return out.toString().trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT).ifEmpty { "(нет совпадений)" }
    }

    private fun doApplyPatch(args: JSONObject): String {
        return try {
            val result = ApplyPatch.apply(args.getString("patchText")) { path -> resolve(path) }
            buildString {
                if (result.applied.isNotEmpty()) appendLine(result.applied.joinToString("\n"))
                if (result.skipped.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("skipped: " + result.skipped.joinToString("; "))
            }.trim().ifEmpty { "патч не содержал операций" }
        } catch (e: ApplyPatch.PatchException) {
            "error: ${e.message}"
        }
    }

    private fun doTodoWrite(args: JSONObject): String {
        val arr = args.optJSONArray("todos") ?: return "error: нужен массив todos"
        val list = mutableListOf<Sessions.Todo>()
        for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
            val o = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
            val content = o.optString("content")
            if (content.isEmpty()) continue
            val status = o.optString("status", "pending")
            list += Sessions.Todo(
                id = o.optString("id").ifEmpty { "t$i" },
                content = content,
                status = if (status in listOf("pending", "in_progress", "completed")) status else "pending",
            )
        }
        todos = list
        onTodos?.invoke(list)
        return "todos updated: ${list.size}"
    }

    private fun doWebFetch(args: JSONObject): String {
        val url = args.getString("url")
        if (!url.startsWith("http://") && !url.startsWith("https://")) return "error: только http(s) URL"
        return try {
            val conn = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
            conn.connectTimeout = 10_000
            conn.readTimeout = 30_000
            conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true
            conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; PocketRunAgent/1.3)")
            val status = conn.responseCode
            val body = (if (status in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
                ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
            if (status !in 200..299) return "HTTP $status: ${body.take(300)}"
            val text = stripHtml(body)
            text.take(MAX_WEB).ifEmpty { "(пустой ответ)" }
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
        }
    }

    private fun doSkill(args: JSONObject): String {
        val name = args.getString("name")
        val skill = skills.load(name, projectDir)
            ?: return "error: навык '$name' не найден. Доступны: ${skills.discover(projectDir).joinToString(", ") { it.name }.ifEmpty { "(нет)" }}"
        return skill.content.take(32 * 1024)
    }

    private fun doQuestion(args: JSONObject): String {
        val arr = args.optJSONArray("questions") ?: return "error: нужен массив questions"
        val questions = mutableListOf<Question>()
        for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
            val o = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
            val opts = o.optJSONArray("options") ?: JSONArray()
            questions += Question(
                header = o.optString("header").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
                question = o.optString("question").ifEmpty { "Вопрос" },
                options = (0 until opts.length()).map { opts.optString(it) },
            )
        }
        if (questions.isEmpty()) return "error: нет вопросов"
        val asker = questionAsker ?: return "(вопросы недоступны в этом режиме)"
        return asker(questions)
    }

    private fun doGitHub(args: JSONObject): String {
        if (githubToken.isBlank()) {
            return "error: GitHub-токен не задан — откройте ⚙ → GitHub и вставьте PAT (scopes repo, workflow)"
        }
        val gh = GitHubClient(githubToken)
        val op = args.optString("op")
        return try {
            when (op) {
                "me" -> gh.me()
                "repo_list" -> gh.repoList()
                "repo_create" -> gh.repoCreate(
                    name = args.getString("name"),
                    private = args.optBoolean("private", true),
                    description = args.optString("description").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
                )
                "push" -> {
                    val arr = args.optJSONArray("files") ?: return "error: нужен массив files[{path,content}]"
                    val files = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>()
                    for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
                        val f = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
                        val p = f.optString("path")
                        if (p.isNotEmpty()) files += p to f.optString("content")
                    }
                    if (files.isEmpty()) return "error: files пуст"
                    gh.pushFiles(args.getString("repo"), files, args.optString("message", "update"), args.optString("branch").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                }
                "file_get" -> gh.fileGet(args.getString("repo"), args.getString("path"), args.optString("ref").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                "file_delete" -> {
                    val arr = args.optJSONArray("paths")
                        ?: return "error: нужен массив paths[]"
                    val paths = (0 until arr.length()).mapNotNull { arr.optString(it).takeIf { p -> p.isNotEmpty() } }
                    if (paths.isEmpty()) return "error: paths пуст"
                    gh.deleteFiles(
                        args.getString("repo"), paths,
                        args.optString("message", "remove files"),
                        args.optString("branch").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
                    )
                }
                "workflow_create" -> gh.workflowCreate(args.getString("repo"), args.optString("filename", "run.yml"), args.getString("yaml"))
                "dispatch" -> gh.dispatch(args.getString("repo"), args.getString("workflow"), args.optString("ref").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                "runs" -> gh.runs(args.getString("repo"), args.optInt("limit", 10))
                "run_wait" -> gh.runWait(
                    repo = args.getString("repo"),
                    runId = args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L },
                    timeoutSec = args.optInt("timeout_sec", 600),
                    isCancelled = { cancelCheck?.invoke() == true },
                )
                "run_cancel" -> gh.runCancel(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("run_id"))
                "logs" -> gh.logs(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("run_id"))
                "artifacts" -> gh.artifacts(args.getString("repo"), args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L })
                "artifact_download" -> gh.artifactDownload(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("artifact_id"))
                "api" -> gh.api(args.optString("method", "GET"), args.getString("api_path"), args.optString("body").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                else -> "error: неизвестная операция '$op' (me, repo_list, repo_create, push, file_delete, file_get, workflow_create, dispatch, runs, run_wait, run_cancel, logs, artifacts, artifact_download, api)"
            }
        } catch (e: GitHubClient.GitHubException) {
            "error: ${e.message}"
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

    private fun resolve(path: String): File? = workspace.resolve(path, base())

    private fun countOccurrences(text: String, needle: String): Int {
        var count = 0
        var idx = 0
        while (true) {
            idx = text.indexOf(needle, idx)
            if (idx < 0) return count
            count++
            idx += needle.length
        }
    }

    private fun globToRegex(pattern: String): Regex {
        val regex = buildString {
            append('^')
            var i = 0
            while (i < pattern.length) {
                when (val c = pattern[i]) {
                    '*' -> if (i + 1 < pattern.length && pattern[i + 1] == '*') { append(".*"); i++ } else append("[^/]*")
                    '?' -> append('.')
                    else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)
                }
                i++
            }
            append('$')
        }
        return Regex(regex)
    }

    private fun stripHtml(html: String): String {
        return html
            .replace(Regex("(?is)<(script|style)[^>]*>.*?</\\1>"), " ")
            .replace(Regex("(?s)<!--.*?-->"), " ")
            .replace(Regex("(?s)<br[^>]*>|</p>|</div>|</li>"), "\n")
            .replace(Regex("(?s)<[^>]+>"), " ")
            .replace(" ", " ").replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<")
            .replace(">", ">").replace(""", "\"").replace("'", "'")
            .replace(Regex("[ \\t\\x0B\\f\\r]+"), " ")
            .replace(Regex("\\n\\s*\\n+"), "\n")
            .trim()
    }
}

542:         npxRuntime.installedPackages().forEach { (n, v) -> out.append("  $n@$v\n") }
543:         return Result(0, out.toString().ifEmpty { "(ничего не установлено)\n" })

546:     private fun runCodeFile(ext: String, code: String, dir: File, timeoutMs: Long, python: Boolean): Result {
547:         val scratch = File(workspace.cache, "opencode-shell").apply { mkdirs() }
548:         val f = File(scratch, "cmd.${if (python) "py" else "js"}")

553:         } else {

556:         return Result(r.exitCode, r.stdout + (if (r.stderr.isNotBlank()) r.stderr else ""))

561:     private fun writeToFile(f: File, content: String, append: Boolean) {
562:         try {
563:             f.parentFile?.mkdirs()

568:     private fun sandboxPath(p: String, dir: File): File? = workspace.resolve(p, dir)

570:     /** Shell tokenizer: single/double quotes keep groups together. */
571:     internal fun tokenize(line: String): List<String> {
572:         val out = mutableListOf<String>()
573:         val cur = StringBuilder()
574:         var quote: Char? = null
575:         var has = false
576:         var i = 0
577:         while (i < line.length) {
578:             val c = line[i]
579:             when {
580:                 quote != null -> {
581:                     if (c == quote) quote = null else cur.append(c)
582:                 }
583:                 c == '"' || c == '\'' -> { quote = c; has = true }
584:                 c.isWhitespace() -> {
585:                     if (cur.isNotEmpty() || has) { out += cur.toString(); cur.clear(); has = false }
586:                 }
587:                 else -> cur.append(c)
588:             }
589:             i++
590:         }
591:         if (cur.isNotEmpty() || has) out += cur.toString()
592:         return out
593:     }
594: 
595:     /** Glob match with `*`, `?` and `**` support. */
596:     internal fun globMatch(pattern: String, path: String): Boolean {
597:         val regex = buildString {
598:             append('^')
599:             var i = 0
600:             while (i < pattern.length) {
601:                 when (val c = pattern[i]) {
602:                     '*' -> if (i + 1 < pattern.length && pattern[i + 1] == '*') { append(".*"); i++ } else append("[^/]*")
603:                     '?' -> append('.')
604:                     else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)
605:                 }
606:                 i++
607:             }
608:             append('$')
609:         }
610:         return Regex(regex).matches(path)
611:     }
612: 
613:     private fun cap(text: String): String =
614:         if (text.length <= MAX_OUTPUT) text else text.take(MAX_OUTPUT) + "\n… (обрезано)"
615: }

119:         val repoJson = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo", "repo info"))
120:         return repoJson.optString("default_branch", "main").ifEmpty { "main" }

123:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ops

125:     fun me(): String {
126:         val o = JSONObject(get("/user", "user"))
127:         return "login=${o.optString("login")} name=${o.optString("name")}"
128:     }

130:     fun repoList(): String {
131:         val arr = JSONArray(get("/user/repos?sort=updated&per_page=30", "repo_list"))
132:         val sb = StringBuilder()
133:         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
134:             val r = arr.getJSONObject(i)
135:             sb.append("${r.optString("full_name")}  ${if (r.optBoolean("private")) "[private]" else "[public]"}  → ${r.optString("html_url")}\n")
136:         }

140:     fun repoCreate(name: String, private: Boolean, description: String?): String {
141:         val body = JSONObject().put("name", name).put("private", private)
142:         if (!description.isNullOrBlank()) body.put("description", description)
143:         val o = JSONObject(ok(call("POST", "/user/repos", body.toString()), "repo_create"))
144:         return "создан ${o.optString("full_name")} → ${o.optString("html_url")} (default branch: ${o.optString("default_branch", "main")})"

147:     /**
148:      * Commits files in ONE commit through the git data API: blobs → tree →
149:      * commit → ref update. The contents API would make a separate commit per
150:      * file (a workflow and its sources would land as five commits and could
151:      * trigger five runs), and it needs a GET per file to find the sha.
152:      */
153:     fun pushFiles(repo: String, files: List<Pair<String, String>>, message: String, branch: String?): String {
154:         if (files.isEmpty()) return "(нечего коммитить)"
155:         return commit(repo, files.map { Change(it.first, it.second) }, message, branch)
156:     }

158:     /** Deletes paths in one commit. */
159:     fun deleteFiles(repo: String, paths: List<String>, message: String, branch: String?): String {
160:         if (paths.isEmpty()) return "(нечего удалять)"
161:         return commit(repo, paths.map { Change(it, null, delete = true) }, message, branch)
162:     }
163: 
164:     private fun commit(repo: String, changes: List<Change>, message: String, branch: String?): String {
165:         val ref = branchName(repo, branch)
166:         return try {
167:             gitCommit(repo, changes, message, ref)
168:         } catch (e: GitHubException) {
169:             // The git data API can be unavailable for some tokens/scopes; the
170:             // contents API is the slower but wider path.
171:             if (changes.any { it.delete }) {
172:                 changes.forEach { contentsDelete(repo, it.path, message) }
173:                 return "удалено в $ref: ${changes.joinToString(", ") { it.path }}"
174:             }
175:             contentsCommit(repo, changes, message, ref)
176:         }
177:     }

179:     private fun gitCommit(repo: String, changes: List<Change>, message: String, branch: String): String {
180:         // One retry covers the case where someone pushed to the branch between
181:         // our read of the ref and our update of it.
182:         repeat(2) { attempt ->
183:             val head = headCommit(repo, branch)
184:             val baseTree = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/git/commits/$head", "git commit"))
185:                 .optJSONObject("tree")?.optString("sha").orEmpty()
186:             val tree = JSONArray()
187:             for (c in changes) {
188:                 val entry = JSONObject().put("path", c.path).put("mode", "100644").put("type", "blob")
189:                 if (c.delete) {
190:                     entry.put("sha", JSONObject.NULL)
191:                 } else {
192:                     val blob = JSONObject()
193:                         .put("content", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString((c.content ?: "").toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)))
194:                         .put("encoding", "base64")
195:                     val sha = JSONObject(ok(call("POST", "/repos/$repo/git/blobs", blob.toString()), "git blob"))
196:                         .optString("sha")
197:                     entry.put("sha", sha)
198:                 }
199:                 tree.put(entry)
200:             }
201:             val treeSha = JSONObject(
202:                 ok(
203:                     call(
204:                         "POST", "/repos/$repo/git/trees",
205:                         JSONObject().put("base_tree", baseTree).put("tree", tree).toString(),
206:                     ),
207:                     "git tree",
208:                 ),
209:             ).optString("sha")
210:             val commitSha = JSONObject(
211:                 ok(
212:                     call(
213:                         "POST", "/repos/$repo/git/commits",
214:                         JSONObject()
215:                             .put("message", message.ifBlank { "update" })
216:                             .put("tree", treeSha)
217:                             .put("parents", JSONArray().put(head))
218:                             .toString(),
219:                     ),
220:                     "git commit create",
221:                 ),
222:             ).optString("sha")
223:             val refPath = "/repos/$repo/git/refs/heads/$branch"
224:             val update = call("PATCH", refPath, JSONObject().put("sha", commitSha).put("force", false).toString())
225:             if (update.status in 200..299) {
226:                 return "коммит ${commitSha.take(7)} → $branch (${changes.size} " +
227:                     "${plural(changes.size, "файл", "файла", "файлов")}): " +
228:                     changes.joinToString(", ") { it.path }.take(600)
229:             }
230:             if (update.status == 422 && attempt == 0) return@repeat
231:             ok(update, "обновление ветки $branch")
232:         }
233:         throw GitHubException("ветка $branch всё время меняется — повторите push")
234:     }
235: 
236:     private fun headCommit(repo: String, branch: String): String =
237:         JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/git/ref/heads/$branch", "ветка $branch"))
238:             .optJSONObject("object")?.optString("sha").orEmpty()
239:             .ifEmpty { throw GitHubException("ветка $branch не найдена") }
240: 
241:     /** Fallback path: one contents-API commit per file. */
242:     private fun contentsCommit(repo: String, changes: List<Change>, message: String, branch: String): String {
243:         val sb = StringBuilder()
244:         for (c in changes) {
245:             val existing = call("GET", "/repos/$repo/contents/${c.path}?ref=$branch")
246:             val sha = if (existing.status == 200) JSONObject(existing.text).optString("sha").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() } else null
247:             val body = JSONObject()
248:                 .put("message", message.ifBlank { "update" })
249:                 .put("content", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString((c.content ?: "").toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)))
250:                 .put("branch", branch)
251:             if (sha != null) body.put("sha", sha)
252:             val answer = ok(call("PUT", "/repos/$repo/contents/${c.path}", body.toString()), "push ${c.path}")
253:             val commit = JSONObject(answer).optJSONObject("commit")?.optString("sha")?.take(7) ?: "?"
254:             sb.append("коммит $commit · ${c.path}\n")
255:         }
256:         return sb.toString().trim()
257:     }
258: 
259:     private fun contentsDelete(repo: String, path: String, message: String): String {
260:         val existing = call("GET", "/repos/$repo/contents/$path")
261:         if (existing.status == 404) return "нет такого файла: $path"
262:         val sha = JSONObject(existing.text).optString("sha")
263:         ok(
264:             call("DELETE", "/repos/$repo/contents/$path", JSONObject().put("message", message).put("sha", sha).toString()),
265:             "удаление $path",
266:         )
267:         return "удалён $path"
268:     }
269: 
270:     fun fileGet(repo: String, path: String, ref: String?): String {
271:         val q = if (ref.isNullOrBlank()) "" else "?ref=$ref"
272:         val t = get("/repos/$repo/contents/$path$q", "file_get", raw = true)
273:         return t.take(MAX_OUTPUT) + if (t.length > MAX_OUTPUT) "\n… (обрезано)" else ""
274:     }
275: 
276:     fun workflowCreate(repo: String, filename: String, yaml: String): String =
277:         pushFiles(repo, listOf(".github/workflows/$filename" to yaml), "workflow: $filename", null)
278: 
279:     /** Triggers workflow_dispatch. `workflow` is the file name, e.g. run.yml. */
280:     fun dispatch(repo: String, workflow: String, ref: String?): String {
281:         val branch = ref ?: branchName(repo, null)
282:         val body = JSONObject().put("ref", branch)
283:         ok(call("POST", "/repos/$repo/actions/workflows/$workflow/dispatches", body.toString()), "dispatch")
284:         return "workflow $workflow запущен (branch $branch). Дождаться результата: github run_wait {\"repo\":\"$repo\",\"timeout_sec\":600}"
285:     }
286: 
287:     fun runs(repo: String, limit: Int): String {
288:         val arr = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/actions/runs?per_page=${limit.coerceIn(1, 30)}", "runs"))
289:             .optJSONArray("workflow_runs") ?: JSONArray()
290:         val sb = StringBuilder()
291:         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
292:             sb.append(runLine(arr.getJSONObject(i))).append('\n')
293:         }
294:         return sb.toString().ifEmpty { "(запусков нет)" }
295:     }
296: 
297:     private fun runLine(r: JSONObject): String {
298:         val conclusion = r.optString("conclusion").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it != "null" } ?: "…"
299:         return "run #${r.optLong("run_number")} id=${r.optLong("id")} ${r.optString("status")}/$conclusion " +
300:             "${r.optString("name")} (${r.optString("event")}, ${r.optString("created_at")})"
301:     }
302: 
303:     /**
304:      * Blocks until the run finishes — one tool call instead of a polling loop
305:      * that burns a round every few seconds. Reports the conclusion, the jobs
306:      * and, when something failed, the tail of the log, which is exactly what
307:      * "сборка упала, почему?" needs.
308:      */
309:     fun runWait(
310:         repo: String,
311:         runId: Long?,
312:         timeoutSec: Int,
313:         isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
314:         logLines: Int = 40,
315:     ): String {
316:         val id = runId ?: latestRunId(repo)
317:         val budget = timeoutSec.coerceIn(15, MAX_WAIT_SEC) * 1000L
318:         val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + budget
319:         var run: JSONObject
320:         var waited = 0
321:         while (true) {
322:             run = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/actions/runs/$id", "запуск $id"))
323:             if (run.optString("status") == "completed") break
324:             val left = deadline - System.currentTimeMillis()
325:             if (left <= 0) {
326:                 return "запуск ${run.optLong("run_number")} (id=$id) всё ещё ${run.optString("status")} " +
327:                     "через ${timeoutSec}с — он продолжается на раннере; вызови github run_wait ещё раз " +
328:                     "или отмени его: github run_cancel {\"repo\":\"$repo\",\"run_id\":$id}"
329:             }
330:             if (isCancelled()) return "ожидание отменено пользователем (запуск $id продолжается на раннере)"
331:             val napMs = minOf(WAIT_POLL_MS, left)
332:             waited += napMs.toInt()
333:             Thread.sleep(napMs)
334:         }
335:         val sb = StringBuilder()
336:         val conclusion = run.optString("conclusion")
337:         val shown = run.optString("conclusion").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it != "null" } ?: "…"
338:         sb.append("запуск #${run.optLong("run_number")} id=$id: ${run.optString("status")}/$shown «${run.optString("name")}»\n")
339:         sb.append("длительность: ${durationSec(run)}с, ожидание: ${waited / 1000}с\n")
340:         sb.append("ссылка: ${run.optString("html_url")}\n")
341:         jobsSummary(repo, id)?.let { sb.append(it) }
342:         if (!conclusion.equals("success", ignoreCase = true)) {
343:             sb.append("— логи (хвост) —\n")
344:             sb.append(logTail(repo, id, logLines))
345:         }
346:         return sb.toString()
347:     }
348: 
349:     private fun latestRunId(repo: String): Long {
350:         val arr = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/actions/runs?per_page=1", "runs"))
351:             .optJSONArray("workflow_runs") ?: JSONArray()
352:         if (arr.length() == 0) throw GitHubException("в $repo ещё не было запусков — сначала github dispatch")
353:         return arr.getJSONObject(0).optLong("id")
354:     }
355: 
356:     private fun durationSec(run: JSONObject): Long {
357:         val created = run.optString("created_at")
358:         val updated = run.optString("updated_at")
359:         return if (created.isEmpty() || updated.isEmpty()) 0 else seconds(created, updated)
360:     }
361: 
362:     /** ISO-8601 like 2026-09-27T10:00:00Z — parsed without java.time (API 26). */
363:     private fun seconds(from: String, to: String): Long = try {
364:         val format = java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'", Locale.US)
365:         format.timeZone = java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
366:         format.parse(to).time / 1000 - format.parse(from).time / 1000
367:     } catch (t: Throwable) {
368:         0
369:     }
370: 
371:     private fun jobsSummary(repo: String, runId: Long): String? {
372:         val arr = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/actions/runs/$runId/jobs", "jobs"))
373:             .optJSONArray("jobs") ?: return null
374:         if (arr.length() == 0) return null
375:         val sb = StringBuilder("задачи:\n")
376:         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
377:             val job = arr.getJSONObject(i)
378:             val conclusion = job.optString("conclusion").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it != "null" } ?: job.optString("status")
379:             sb.append("  ${job.optString("name")}: $conclusion")
380:             val steps = job.optJSONArray("steps")
381:             if (steps != null && !conclusion.equals("success", ignoreCase = true)) {
382:                 val failed = mutableListOf<String>()
383:                 for (s in 0 until steps.length()) {
384:                     val step = steps.getJSONObject(s)
385:                     val sc = step.optString("conclusion")
386:                     if (sc.isNotEmpty() && sc != "success" && sc != "skipped") failed += step.optString("name")
387:                 }
388:                 if (failed.isNotEmpty()) sb.append(" (упали шаги: ${failed.joinToString(", ")})")
389:             }
390:             sb.append('\n')
391:         }
392:         return sb.toString()
393:     }
394: 
395:     private fun logTail(repo: String, runId: Long, lines: Int): String = try {
396:         val text = stream("GET", "/repos/$repo/actions/runs/$runId/logs").use { ins -> zipToText(ins, MAX_ZIP_TEXT) }
397:         val all = text.lines().filter { it.isNotBlank() }
398:         if (all.size <= lines) all.joinToString("\n").ifEmpty { "(логи пусты)" }
399:         else all.takeLast(lines).joinToString("\n").let { "…\n$it" }
400:     } catch (t: Throwable) {
401:         "не удалось прочитать логи: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
402:     }
403: 
404:     fun runCancel(repo: String, runId: Long): String {
405:         ok(call("POST", "/repos/$repo/actions/runs/$runId/cancel", "{}"), "отмена запуска")
406:         return "запуск $runId отменён"
407:     }
408: 
409:     /** Run logs come as a zip of per-job text files. */
410:     fun logs(repo: String, runId: Long): String {
411:         stream("GET", "/repos/$repo/actions/runs/$runId/logs").use { ins ->
412:             return zipToText(ins, MAX_ZIP_TEXT).ifEmpty { "(логи пусты)" }
413:         }
414:     }
415: 
416:     fun artifacts(repo: String, runId: Long?): String {
417:         val q = if (runId != null) "?run_id=$runId" else ""
418:         val arr = JSONObject(get("/repos/$repo/actions/artifacts$q", "artifacts"))
419:             .optJSONArray("artifacts") ?: JSONArray()
420:         val sb = StringBuilder()
421:         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
422:             val a = arr.getJSONObject(i)
423:             sb.append("id=${a.optLong("id")} ${a.optString("name")} ${a.optLong("size_in_bytes")} bytes (run ${a.optLong("run_id")})\n")
424:         }
425:         return sb.toString().ifEmpty { "(артефактов нет)" }
426:     }
427: 
428:     /** Lists an artifact's files and inlines the small text ones. */
429:     fun artifactDownload(repo: String, artifactId: Long): String {
430:         stream("GET", "/repos/$repo/actions/artifacts/$artifactId/zip").use { ins ->
431:             return zipToText(ins, MAX_ZIP_TEXT).ifEmpty { "(пусто)" }
432:         }
433:     }
434: 
435:     /** Escape hatch: any GitHub REST call, e.g. PRs, issues, releases. */
436:     fun api(method: String, path: String, body: String?): String {
437:         val m = method.uppercase()
438:         if (m !in setOf("GET", "POST", "PATCH", "PUT", "DELETE")) throw GitHubException("метод $m не поддерживается")
439:         if (!path.startsWith("/")) throw GitHubException("path должен начинаться с /, например /repos/owner/name")
440:         val answer = call(m, path, body?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() })
441:         val text = ok(answer, "api $m $path")
442:         return if (text.isBlank()) "(пустой ответ ${answer.status})" else pretty(text)
443:     }
444: 
445:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- zip
446: 
447:     /** Reads a zip stream: lists entries and inlines the small text ones. */
448:     private fun zipToText(ins: InputStream, cap: Int): String {
449:         val sb = StringBuilder()
450:         java.util.zip.ZipInputStream(ins).use { zip ->
451:             var entry = zip.nextEntry
452:             val buf = ByteArray(8192)
453:             while (entry != null && sb.length < cap) {
454:                 if (!entry.isDirectory) {
455:                     sb.append("── ").append(entry.name).append('\n')
456:                     if (looksTexty(entry.name)) {
457:                         val text = StringBuilder()
458:                         while (true) {
459:                             val n = zip.read(buf)
460:                             if (n <= 0 || text.length >= cap - sb.length) break
461:                             text.append(String(buf, 0, n, Charsets.UTF_8))
462:                         }
463:                         sb.append(text).append('\n')
464:                     }
465:                 }
466:                 entry = zip.nextEntry
467:             }
468:         }
469:         return sb.toString().take(cap)
470:     }
471: 
472:     private fun looksTexty(name: String): Boolean {
473:         if (name.endsWith(".png") || name.endsWith(".jpg") || name.endsWith(".jar") || name.endsWith(".apk") ||
474:             name.endsWith(".zip") || name.endsWith(".dex") || name.endsWith(".so") || name.endsWith(".bin")
475:         ) return false
476:         return true
477:     }
478: 
479:     private fun plural(n: Int, one: String, few: String, many: String): String = when {
480:         n % 10 == 1 && n % 100 != 11 -> one
481:         n % 10 in 2..4 && n % 100 !in 12..14 -> few
482:         else -> many
483:     }
484: }

(End of file - total 484 lines)

package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode

import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.InputStream
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL
import java.util.Base64
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * The `github` tool backend: a compact GitHub REST client. It lets the agent
 * manage repositories and **GitHub Actions runners** entirely from the app:
 * create a repo, commit files (including workflow files under
 * `.github/workflows`) in a single atomic commit, dispatch a workflow, block
 * until the run finishes, read logs and download artifacts. Inside an
 * `ubuntu-latest` runner anything can run — npm packages, opencode itself,
 * real compilers — which is the "heavy work" escape hatch of the mobile
 * sandbox.
 */

parts.text:
Let me note findings so far and continue reading other core files.

Findings so far:
- MiniShell.kt:200 `env` returns a constant ignoring args; line 208 `uname` returns a hardcoded "Linux aarch64 PocketRun".
- MiniShell.kt:565 `writeToFile` catch (_: Exception) { } — silently swallows errors (redirection failures produce exit code 0 and no error).
- MiniShell.kt:173 `pwd` — `dir.relativeToOrNull(...)?.let { "./$it" } ?: dir.absolutePath + "\n"` — operator precedence bug: `?.let{}` returns "./x" without newline, else absolutePath + "\n". So pwd output has no trailing newline. Minor bug. Actually that's a real inconsistency — pwd without trailing newline.
- MiniShell.kt:530 `npmRun` calls `execute(cmd, dir, timeoutMs)` — does not handle `pre`/`post` scripts, no `&&` exit code. Also recursion — execute on the whole script. OK.
- MiniShell.kt:249 in ls: `e.length()` for directories returns 0 (file length). Minor.
- MiniShell.kt:341 `wc` uses `files.last()` only — ignores multiple files. Approximation.
- MiniShell.kt:379 shellGrep filters out all args starting with "-", so flags like `-v`, `-r` are silently dropped, and only the first file is used (rest[1]) — grep with multiple files ignores the rest. Also `grep -r` not supported but silently treated as if not passed. That's an approximation issue: `grep -v` would silently produce wrong output.
- MiniShell.kt:388 headTail only uses files[0] — ignores other files.
- MiniShell.kt:142-145: pipes into runtime commands ignore stdin. `echo hi | python -c '...'` would run with empty stdin. Documented in comment at line 140.
- MiniShell.kt:466 npm catch — fine.
- MiniShell.kt:596 globMatch: `*` -> `[^/]*`, `**` -> `.*`. But `**/` handling: pattern "**/*.py" becomes "^.*/[^/]*\.py$" which won't match a top-level "a.py" (no slash). Real glob `**/*.py` matches "a.py" in most glob impls. Same bug in OpenCodeTools.globToRegex. That's a real bug: `glob **/*.py` won't match files at the root. Let me verify: pattern "**/*.py": i=0 '*' and pattern[1]=='*' -> append ".*", i++ -> i=1 then i++ -> 2 which is '/', append '/', then '*' -> "[^/]*", ".py". So regex = "^.*/[^/]*\.py$". Matching rel path "a.py" -> needs ".*/" prefix, so no match. Yes — real bug. And the tool description at OpenCodeTools.kt:141 explicitly advertises '**/*.py' as example. That is a CORE finding.

Also `include` in grep: same globToRegex with `*.py` fine.

- OpenCodeTools.kt:306 `doBash` — returns only stdout from MiniShell, and `out.take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT)` (16k) applied after MiniShell cap 32k. Fine.
- OpenCodeTools.kt:321 doRead: `(body.take(MAX_READ) + if (body.length > MAX_READ) ...)` — fine but truncation mid-line.
- OpenCodeTools.kt:385 doGrep: `if (out.length > MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT) return@forEach` — continues walking the whole tree (no early break), just skips. Inefficient but works. Also it truncates per-line 300 chars.
- OpenCodeTools.kt:364 doGlob: `base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root` — if the path doesn't exist, silently searches the whole workspace root instead of reporting an error. Same in doGrep:381. That's a silent fallback that hides errors — a real finding (a wrong path searches everything).
- OpenCodeTools.kt:468 doQuestion: returns "(вопросы недоступны в этом режиме)" if asker is null — silent no-op.
- OpenCodeTools.kt:282-284: catch(Throwable) returns "error: message" — swallows stack but fine.
- OpenCodeTools.kt:237: `files` array item schema has no `required`? It has. ok.
- github description mentions `run_wait{repo,run_id?,timeout_sec?}` etc. Check ops: me, repo_list, repo_create, push, file_delete, file_get, workflow_create, dispatch, runs, run_wait, run_cancel, logs, artifacts, artifact_download, api — all implemented. Also `body` in the api op is a string, but description says `api{method,path,body?}` and property name is `api_path`. Slight mismatch: description says "path" but property is `api_path". Minor.
- READ_OPS missing "me"? no it has me. It includes run_wait as read. Fine.
- GitHubClient.kt:230-231: `if (update.status == 422 && attempt == 0) return@repeat` then `ok(update, ...)` — on attempt 1 a 422 throws. fine.
- GitHubClient.kt:163-177 commit(): on GitHubException fallback, the deletes path calls contentsDelete but doesn't check result; returns message claiming all deleted even if some failed (contentsDelete returns "нет такого файла" strings which are discarded). Real: silent partial failure. IMPORTANT.

package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode

import dev.pocketrun.agent.LlmClient
import dev.pocketrun.core.Workspace
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File

/**
 * The opencode agent loop: user message in, tool calls out, tool results back
 * in, repeat until a plain-text answer (or the round budget). The system prompt
 * is assembled opencode-style: base agent prompt + AGENTS.md instructions +
 * current todos; skills are advertised through the `skill` tool description.
 *
 * Long turns are the normal case, not the exception, so the loop is built for
 * them: the answer is streamed (so the connection never goes idle and ⏹ works),
 * the history is trimmed before every request (so the prompt stays inside the
 * model's context), and a turn that runs out of rounds is saved instead of lost
 * — the user continues it with `/continue`.
 */

433:                 val n = input.read(buf)
434:                 if (n < 0) break
435:                 out.write(buf, 0, n)
436:                 total += n
437:             }
438:             out.toString("UTF-8")
439:         }
440:     }

442:     /** Forwards tailer output and keeps a capped copy for the final ExecResult. */
443:     private class CaptureListener(
444:         private val downstream: OutputListener,
445:         private val capture: Capture,
446:     ) : OutputListener {
447:         override fun onOutput(stream: OutputStream, text: String) {
448:             capture.append(text)
449:             downstream.onOutput(stream, text)
450:         }
451:     }
452: 
453:     private class Capture {
454:         private val builder = StringBuilder()
455:         var truncated = false
456:             private set
457: 
458:         fun append(text: String) {
459:             if (truncated) return
460:             val room = MAX_CAPTURE - builder.length
461:             if (room <= 0) { truncated = true; return }
462:             if (text.length <= room) builder.append(text) else {
463:                 builder.append(text, 0, room)
464:                 truncated = true
465:             }
466:         }
467: 
468:         fun text(): String = builder.toString()

353:     internal fun resolveBin(pkgDir: File, name: String): File? {
354:         val manifest = readManifest(manifestOf(pkgDir)) ?: return null
355:         val bin = manifest.opt("bin") ?: return null
356:         val rel = when (bin) {
357:             is String -> bin
358:             is JSONObject -> {
359:                 val short = name.substringAfterLast('/')
360:                 bin.optString(short).takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
361:                     ?: bin.keys().asSequence().firstOrNull()?.let { bin.getString(it) }
362:             }
363:             else -> return null
364:         } ?: return null
365:         val f = File(pkgDir, rel).toPath().normalize().toFile()
366:         return f.takeIf { it.isFile }
367:     }

5:  * (`^1.2.3`, `~1.2`, `>=1.0 <2.0`, `1.2.x`, `*`, `||`, exact, dist-tags are

11:     data class V(val major: Int, val minor: Int, val patch: Int, val pre: List<String>) {
12:         val isStable: Boolean get() = pre.isEmpty()
13:     }
14: 
15:     private val FULL = Regex("""^v?(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)(?:-([0-9A-Za-z.\-]+))?${'$'}""")

17:     fun parse(s: String?): V? {
18:         if (s == null) return null
19:         val m = FULL.matchEntire(s.trim()) ?: return null
20:         return V(
21:             m.groupValues[1].toInt(),
22:             m.groupValues[2].toInt(),
23:             m.groupValues[3].toInt(),
24:             m.groupValues[4].takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.split('.') ?: emptyList(),
25:         )

28:     fun compare(a: V, b: V): Int {
29:         (a.major.compareTo(b.major)).let { if (it != 0) return it }
30:         (a.minor.compareTo(b.minor)).let { if (it != 0) return it }
31:         (a.patch.compareTo(b.patch)).let { if (it != 0) return it }
32:         // A stable version sorts above any prerelease of the same numbers.
33:         if (a.pre.isEmpty() && b.pre.isEmpty()) return 0
34:         if (a.pre.isEmpty()) return 1
35:         if (b.pre.isEmpty()) return -1
36:         val n = minOf(a.pre.size, b.pre.size)
37:         for (i in 0 until n) {
38:             val x = a.pre[i]; val y = b.pre[i]
39:             val xn = x.toIntOrNull(); val yn = y.toIntOrNull()
40:             val c = when {
41:                 xn != null && yn != null -> xn.compareTo(yn)
42:                 xn != null -> -1 // numeric < alphanumeric
43:                 yn != null -> 1
44:                 else -> x.compareTo(y)

22:     private val _state = MutableStateFlow(evaluate())
23:     val state: StateFlow<LicenseState> = _state.asStateFlow()
24: 
25:     sealed interface LicenseState {
26:         data object NeedsActivation : LicenseState
27:         data class Active(
28:             val claims: LicenseFormat.Claims,
29:             val fingerprint: String,
30:             val daysRemaining: Long?,
31:         ) : LicenseState {
32:             val canUseAgent: Boolean get() = claims.plan in AGENT_PLANS
33:         }
34: 
35:         data class Rejected(val message: String) : LicenseState
36:     }
37: 
38:     /** Accepts a pasted key. Returns true when it verified. */
39:     fun activate(rawKey: String): Boolean {
40:         val key = LicenseFormat.normalize(rawKey)
41:         if (key.isEmpty()) {
42:             _state.value = LicenseState.Rejected("Enter a license key.")
43:             return false
44:         }
45:         return when (val outcome = LicenseVerifier.verify(key, publicKey, now())) {
46:             is LicenseVerifier.Outcome.Valid -> {
47:                 prefs.edit().putString(KEY, key).apply()
48:                 _state.value = LicenseState.Active(
49:                     claims = outcome.claims,
50:                     fingerprint = outcome.keyFingerprint,
51:                     daysRemaining = LicenseVerifier.daysRemaining(outcome.claims, now()),
52:                 )
53:                 true
54:             }
55: 
56:             is LicenseVerifier.Outcome.Expired -> {
57:                 _state.value = LicenseState.Rejected("This license expired.")
58:                 false
59:             }
60: 
61:             is LicenseVerifier.Outcome.NotYetValid -> {
62:                 _state.value = LicenseState.Rejected("This license is not valid yet.")
63:                 false
64:             }
65: 
66:             is LicenseVerifier.Outcome.Rejected -> {
67:                 _state.value = LicenseState.Rejected(outcome.reason)
68:                 false
69:             }
70:         }
71:     }
72:

74:         prefs.edit().remove(KEY).apply()
75:         _state.value = LicenseState.NeedsActivation
76:     }

79:         val stored = prefs.getString(KEY, null)
80:         if (stored.isNullOrBlank()) return LicenseState.NeedsActivation
81:         return when (val outcome = LicenseVerifier.verify(stored, publicKey, now())) {
82:             is LicenseVerifier.Outcome.Valid -> LicenseState.Active(
83:                 claims = outcome.claims,
84:                 fingerprint = outcome.keyFingerprint,
85:                 daysRemaining = LicenseVerifier.daysRemaining(outcome.claims, now()),

package dev.pocketrun.agent

import android.content.Context

/**
 * Agent configuration, stored in SharedPreferences. Works with any
 * OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq,
 * Together, a local llama.cpp/vLLM server on the Wi-Fi network, …
 *
 * Also carries the agent-behaviour knobs (permission mode, max rounds) and
 * the optional GitHub token used by the `github` tool.
 */
object AgentSettings {

    const val DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
    const val DEFAULT_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"

    /** opencode Zen: the curated OpenAI-compatible gateway from opencode.ai/auth. */
    const val ZEN_BASE_URL = "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1"
    const val ZEN_AUTH_URL = "https://opencode.ai/auth"

    /** Where the user creates a GitHub PAT (scopes: repo, workflow). */
    const val GITHUB_TOKEN_URL = "https://github.com/settings/tokens/new?scopes=repo,workflow&description=PocketRun"
    const val GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com"

    /** Permission modes for tool execution. */
    const val MODE_AUTO = "auto"     // everything runs without asking
    const val MODE_MANUAL = "manual" // mutations need a tap; reads run freely
    const val MODE_ASK = "ask"       // the agent asks clarifying questions first
    val MODES = listOf(MODE_AUTO, MODE_MANUAL, MODE_ASK)
    val MODE_LABELS = mapOf(MODE_AUTO to "Авто", MODE_MANUAL to "Вручную", MODE_ASK to "Вопросы")

    /**
     * Model rounds per user request. Each round is one model call plus the
     * tools it asked for, so a real task (edit a project, push it, wait for the
     * CI run, fix what broke) needs dozens of them — the old default of 12
     * stopped agents in the middle of ordinary work.
     */
    const val DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS = 40
    const val MAX_STEPS_LIMIT = 500

    /** Ready-made presets shown in the model settings dialog. */
    data class Preset(val label: String, val baseUrl: String, val model: String)

    val PRESETS = listOf(
        Preset("OpenCode Zen", ZEN_BASE_URL, "claude-sonnet-4-5"),
        Preset("OpenAI", "https://api.openai.com/v1", "gpt-4o-mini"),
        Preset("OpenRouter", "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5"),
        Preset("Groq", "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1", "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"),
    )

    data class Config(
        val baseUrl: String = DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
        val apiKey: String = "",
        val model: String = DEFAULT_MODEL,
        val githubToken: String = "",
        val confirmMode: String = MODE_AUTO,
        val maxSteps: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
    ) {
        /**
         * The API key is optional: local servers (llama.cpp, vLLM) need none,
         * and for Zen the server itself answers 403 without one — which the
         * agent surfaces with a hint. Only URL and model are required.
         */
        val isReady: Boolean get() = baseUrl.isNotBlank() && model.isNotBlank()
        val endpoint: String get() = baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/chat/completions"
        val isZen: Boolean get() = baseUrl.contains("opencode.ai/zen")
        val hasGitHub: Boolean get() = githubToken.isNotBlank()
        val safeMaxSteps: Int get() = maxSteps.coerceIn(1, MAX_STEPS_LIMIT)
    }

    private const val PREFS = "agent"

    fun read(context: Context): Config {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        return Config(
            baseUrl = prefs.getString("baseUrl", DEFAULT_BASE_URL)!!.trim().trimEnd('/').ifBlank { DEFAULT_BASE_URL },
            apiKey = prefs.getString("apiKey", "")!!.trim(),
            model = prefs.getString("model", DEFAULT_MODEL)!!.trim().ifBlank { DEFAULT_MODEL },
            githubToken = prefs.getString("githubToken", "")!!.trim(),
            confirmMode = prefs.getString("confirmMode", MODE_AUTO)!!.trim().let { if (it in MODES) it else MODE_AUTO },
            maxSteps = prefs.getString("maxSteps", DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS.toString())!!.trim().toIntOrNull() ?: DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
        )
    }

    fun save(context: Context, config: Config) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("baseUrl", config.baseUrl.trim().trimEnd('/'))
            .putString("apiKey", config.apiKey.trim())
            .putString("model", config.model.trim())
            .putString("githubToken", config.githubToken.trim())
            .putString("confirmMode", config.confirmMode)
            .putString("maxSteps", config.safeMaxSteps.toString())
            .apply()
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ui state

    /**
     * Which session tab was active and which tabs were open, so the agent
     * chat comes back exactly as it was after the app is closed. Returns null
     * when nothing was saved yet (first launch → continue the latest session).
     */
    data class UiState(val lastSessionId: String?, val openTabs: List<String>)

    fun readUiState(context: Context): UiState? {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        if (!prefs.contains("uiOpenTabs")) return null
        val last = prefs.getString("uiLastSessionId", "")!!.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
        val tabs = prefs.getString("uiOpenTabs", "")!!.split(',').filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        return UiState(last, tabs)
    }

    fun saveUiState(context: Context, lastSessionId: String?, openTabs: List<String>) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("uiLastSessionId", lastSessionId ?: "")
            .putString("uiOpenTabs", openTabs.joinToString(","))
            .apply()
    }
}

1: package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode
2: 
3: import dev.pocketrun.core.Workspace
4: import org.json.JSONArray
5: import org.json.JSONObject
6: import java.io.File
7: import java.util.UUID
8: 
9: /**
10:  * opencode-style sessions: every conversation is stored locally under
11:  * `<workspace>/opencode-data/sessions/<id>.json` with its title, project,
12:  * parent (forks), the OpenAI-format message history and the todo list —
13:  * so a session can be resumed, forked, renamed, exported or deleted.
14:  */
15: class Sessions(private val workspace: Workspace) {
16: 
17:     data class Todo(val id: String, val content: String, val status: String) {
18:         val isActive: Boolean get() = status == "in_progress"
19:         val isDone: Boolean get() = status == "completed"
20:     }
21: 
22:     data class SessionInfo(
23:         val id: String,
24:         var title: String,
25:         val project: String?,
26:         val parentID: String?,
27:         val createdAt: Long,
28:         var updatedAt: Long,
29:         var model: String?,
30:     )
31: 
32:     data class Session(
33:         val info: SessionInfo,
34:         var messages: JSONArray,
35:         var todos: List<Todo>,
36:     )
37: 
38:     private val dir: File get() = File(workspace.root, "opencode-data/sessions").apply { mkdirs() }
39: 
40:     fun create(project: String?, title: String? = null, parentID: String? = null, model: String? = null): Session {
41:         val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
42:         val info = SessionInfo(
43:             id = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "").take(20),
44:             title = title?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "Новая сессия",
45:             project = project,
46:             parentID = parentID,
47:             createdAt = now,
48:             updatedAt = now,
49:             model = model,
50:         )
51:         val session = Session(info, JSONArray(), emptyList())
52:         save(session)
53:         return session
54:     }
55: 
56:     fun list(): List<SessionInfo> =
57:         dir.listFiles { f -> f.isFile && f.name.endsWith(".json") }
58:             .orEmpty()
59:             .mapNotNull { f -> runCatching { readInfo(f) }.getOrNull() }
60:             .sortedByDescending { it.updatedAt }
61: 
62:     fun load(id: String): Session? {
63:         val f = File(dir, "$id.json")
64:         if (!f.isFile) return null
65:         return try {
66:             val json = JSONObject(f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
67:             Session(
68:                 info = SessionInfo(
69:                     id = json.getString("id"),
70:                     title = json.optString("title", "Сессия"),
71:                     project = json.optString("project").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it != "null" },
72:                     parentID = json.optString("parentID").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it != "null" },
73:                     createdAt = json.optLong("createdAt"),
74:                     updatedAt = json.optLong("updatedAt"),
75:                     model = json.optString("model").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it != "null" },
76:                 ),
77:                 messages = json.optJSONArray("messages") ?: JSONArray(),
78:                 todos = parseTodos(json.optJSONArray("todos")),
79:             )
80:         } catch (t: Throwable) {
81:             null
82:         }
83:     }
84: 
85:     fun save(session: Session) {
86:         session.info.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
87:         val todos = JSONArray().apply {
88:             session.todos.forEach { t ->
89:                 put(JSONObject().put("id", t.id).put("content", t.content).put("status", t.status))
90:             }
91:         }
92:         val json = JSONObject()
93:             .put("id", session.info.id)
94:             .put("title", session.info.title)
95:             .put("project", session.info.project ?: JSONObject.NULL)
96:             .put("parentID", session.info.parentID ?: JSONObject.NULL)
97:             .put("createdAt", session.info.createdAt)
98:             .put("updatedAt", session.info.updatedAt)
99:             .put("model", session.info.model ?: JSONObject.NULL)
100:             .put("messages", session.messages)
101:             .put("todos", todos)
102:         File(dir, "${session.info.id}.json").writeText(json.toString(), Charsets.UTF_8)
103:     }
104: 
105:     fun delete(id: String): Boolean = File(dir, "$id.json").delete()
106: 
107:     fun rename(id: String, title: String): Boolean {
108:         val s = load(id) ?: return false
109:         s.info.title = title.trim().take(80).ifEmpty { s.info.title }
110:         save(s)
111:         return true
112:     }
113: 
114:     /** Fork: a copy with a new id, parent set, same history. */
115:     fun fork(id: String): Session? {
116:         val s = load(id) ?: return null
117:         val child = create(
118:             project = s.info.project,
119:             title = s.info.title + " (форк)",
120:             parentID = s.info.id,
121:             model = s.info.model,
122:         )
123:         child.messages = JSONArray(s.messages.toString())
124:         child.todos = s.todos
125:         save(child)
126:         return child
127:     }
128: 
129:     /** Most recently updated session for a project (the `--continue` analog). */
130:     fun latest(project: String?): Session? =
131:         list().firstOrNull { it.project == project }?.let { load(it.id) }
132: 
133:     /** Export a session as readable JSON (the `opencode export` analog). */
134:     fun export(id: String): String? {
135:         val s = load(id) ?: return null
136:         val f = File(workspace.root, "opencode-data/exports").apply { mkdirs() }
137:         val name = "session-${s.info.id}.json"
138:         f.resolve(name).writeText(pretty(s), Charsets.UTF_8)
139:         return f.resolve(name).absolutePath
140:     }
141: 
142:     fun pretty(session: Session): String {
143:         val json = JSONObject()
144:             .put("id", session.info.id)
145:             .put("title", session.info.title)
146:             .put("project", session.info.project ?: JSONObject.NULL)
147:             .put("parent", session.info.parentID ?: JSONObject.NULL)
148:             .put("created", session.info.createdAt)
149:             .put("updated", session.info.updatedAt)
150:             .put("todos", JSONArray().apply { session.todos.forEach { put(it.content + " [" + it.status + "]") } })
151:             .put("messages", session.messages)
152:         return json.toString(2)
153:     }
154: 
155:     private fun readInfo(f: File): SessionInfo? {
156:         val json = JSONObject(f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
157:         if (!json.has("id")) return null
158:         return SessionInfo(

7: /**
8:  * Minimal reader for the `.tgz` tarballs npm serves (ustar format, entries
9:  * rooted at `package/`). Enough for registry packages: regular files and
10:  * directories; symlinks and special entries are skipped, every extracted path
11:  * is forced to stay inside [destDir].
12:  */

14: 
15:     private const val BLOCK = 512
16: 
17:     class TarFormatException(message: String) : Exception(message)
18: 
19:     /** Extracts [tgz] into [destDir], stripping [stripPrefix] from entries. */
20:     fun extract(tgz: File, destDir: File, stripPrefix: String = "package/") {
21:         destDir.mkdirs()
22:         GZIPInputStream(FileInputStream(tgz)).use { gz ->
23:             val header = ByteArray(BLOCK)
24:             while (true) {
25:                 if (!readFully(gz, header)) return
26:                 if (header.all { it == 0.toByte() }) return // end-of-archive block
27:                 var name = cstr(header, 0, 100)
28:                 val size = octal(cstr(header, 124, 12))
29:                 val typeFlag = if (header[156] == 0.toByte()) '0' else header[156].toInt().toChar()
30:                 val prefix = cstr(header, 345, 155)
31:                 if (prefix.isNotEmpty()) name = "$prefix/$name"
32:                 if (name.isEmpty()) skipData(gz, size)
33: 
34:                 val data = if (size > 0) readExact(gz, size) else ByteArray(0)
35: 
36:                 val rel = strip(name, stripPrefix)
37:                 when (typeFlag) {
38:                     '0' -> {
39:                         if (rel != null) {
40:                             val out = safeFile(destDir, rel)
41:                             if (out != null) {
42:                                 out.parentFile?.mkdirs()
43:                                 out.writeBytes(data)
44:                             }
45:                         }
46:                     }
47:                     '5' -> {
48:                         if (rel != null) safeFile(destDir, rel)?.mkdirs()
49:                     }
50:                     else -> Unit // 'x'/'g' pax headers, '2' symlinks, 'L' long names: consumed, ignored
51:                 }
52:             }
53:         }
54:     }
55: 
56:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- format
57: 
58:     private fun cstr(buf: ByteArray, offset: Int, len: Int): String {
59:         var end = offset
60:         val limit = minOf(offset + len, buf.size)
61:         while (end < limit && buf[end] != 0.toByte()) end++
62:         return String(buf, offset, end - offset, Charsets.UTF_8)
63:     }
64: 
65:     private fun octal(s: String): Long {
66:         val t = s.trim(' ', '\u0000')
67:         if (t.isEmpty()) return 0L
68:         return t.toLongOrNull(radix = 8) ?: throw TarFormatException("bad tar size field: '$s'")
69:     }
70: 
71:     private fun readFully(gz: GZIPInputStream, buf: ByteArray): Boolean {
72:         var done = 0
73:         while (done < buf.size) {
74:             val n = gz.read(buf, done, buf.size - done)
75:             if (n < 0) return false
76:             done += n
77:         }
78:         return true
79:     }

82:         val out = ByteArray(size.toInt())

84:         while (done < out.size) {

86:             if (n < 0) throw TarFormatException("archive truncated inside entry data")
87:             done += n

98:         while (left > 0) {

100:             if (n < 0) return
101:             left -= n
102:         }
103:     }

108:         var n = name
109:         while (n.startsWith("./")) n = n.substring(2)
110:         if (n.isEmpty()) return null
111:         if (!prefix.isEmpty()) {
112:             if (!n.startsWith(prefix)) return null
113:             n = n.removePrefix(prefix)
